title: Height-Balanced Watchdog State Machine Invariants in a Zig Implementation of Aether-Delta After Kernel 6.1.0-55
topic: Debian Becomes Unresponsive after 6.1.0-55 Kernel Update
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Kernel 6.1.0-55 introduced a change to the watchdog subsystem that, in the Zig-based Aether-Delta implementation, can lead to an unresponsive state. The core of the implementation is a height-balanced binary search tree that indexes event logs and watchdog pings. We formalise the state-transition semantics of the watchdog, prove that the tree invariant is preserved after every transition, and establish that search, insertion, and rebalancing remain $O(\log N)$ in the worst case. Static analysis of the Zig source on an Intel Xeon 8370C platform confirms the theoretical bounds and reveals no structural violations. The work demonstrates that the unresponsiveness originates from a violation of the height-balance invariant triggered by a kernel-level timing change. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/zig-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261116_090251_debian_becomes_unresponsive_af}
